text.description_html:
Falcon D261M, Deadbolt with Exposed Exterior Trim

This single sided deadbolt is used for locking and unlocking doors from the inside only. The thumbturn operates the deadbolt on one side of the door while, on the other side of the door, there is and plate to cover boreholes. The Falcon D261M Single-Sided Deadbolt has a plate to cover preexisting door preparation holes on the outside of the door. It has an adjustable latch to fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets; and it will fit door thicknesses ranging from 1-3/8" up to 1-7/8".

Features and Specifications of the D-200 Series Thumbturn x Rose:

  • Deadbolt: 1-1/8" x 2-1/4", Square corner faceplate, 1" housing diameter, 1" throw
  • Strike: 1-1/8" x 2-3/4", lipless
  • Trim Ring: 1"
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-3/8" - 1-7/8"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Metal dust box with three - 3" screws
  • BHMA - ANSI A156.5, 200
  • Grade 2 auxiliary lock

Sold Individually NOT Returnable.
